acceptanceCriteria: A default-branch merge commit that introduces an archived Work Item with a valid pre-merge finalization context is classified as an explicit post-merge transition and does not emit a false missing-terminal-decision failure.
A historical archived Work Item that remains unclosed after the transition is still reported as a blocking stale/closure finding on the next non-transition default-branch check.
Direct default-branch commits, malformed merge states, unrelated archived items, and missing/invalid parity evidence remain fail-closed.
The CI workflow passes the event/commit context needed to make the transition decision deterministic without bypassing PR, release, or contract-aware gates.
Regression tests cover merge commit introduction, subsequent closure, stale closure, direct commit, and no global state or source fallback.
Tri-language documentation and parity ledger describe the explicit post-merge transition and preserve the requirement for eventual finalize/close.
Installed v0.2.38 Runtime lifecycle and visible human Outcome are completed for this Work Item.
goal: Make default-branch CI distinguish a reviewed merge commit that newly introduces an archived Work Item awaiting post-merge finalization from a stale historical missing-close condition, and prove the distinction with deterministic tests and documentation.
intent: Eliminate false-failure quality notifications caused by the intentional post-merge finalize/close transition while preserving fail-closed detection of stale unclosed Work Items.
